score_definitions.c_only: LeWM still rolls the candidate to form critic context, but ranking uses only the direct goal critic C.
score_definitions.f_only: LeWM rolls and scores all H predicted states with the normalized discounted latent-goal cost.
score_definitions.f_plus_c: F prefix cost plus discounted direct critic C tail cost.
score_definitions.f_plus_g: F prefix cost plus discounted successor G tail cost.
score_definitions.g_only: LeWM still rolls the candidate to form tail context, but ranking uses only the successor G readout.
